sentences.en: You know, when Chris first approached me to speak at TED, I said no, because I felt like I wasn't going to be able to make that personal connection, you know, that I wanted to.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当克里斯第一次找我在 TED 演讲时，我拒绝了，因为我觉得我无法建立我想要的个人联系。

sentences.en: It's such a large conference. But he explained to me that he was in a bind, and that he was having trouble finding the kind of sex appeal and star power that the conference was known for.
sentences.zh: 这么大的会议。但他向我解释说，他陷入了困境，他很难找到会议所闻名的性感和明星影响力。

sentences.en: So I said fine, Ted -- I mean Chris. I'll come on two conditions.
sentences.zh: 所以我说好吧，特德——我是说克里斯。我来有两个条件。

sentences.en: One: I want to speak as early in the morning as possible.
sentences.zh: 一：我想尽可能早上发言。

sentences.en: And two: I want to pick the theme for TED 2006.
sentences.zh: 第二：我想为 TED 2006 选择主题。

sentences.en: And luckily he agreed. And the theme, in two years, is going to be "Cute Pictures Of Puppies."
sentences.zh: 幸运的是他同意了。两年后的主题将是“小狗的可爱图片”。

sentences.en: (Video) (Music) [How to Dance Properly BASIC TWIRL] [NEW SCHOOL]
sentences.zh: （视频）（音乐）[如何正确跳舞基本旋转] [NEW SCHOOL]

sentences.en: [OLD SCHOOL] [WHO'S YOUR DADDY?] ["RIDE THE PONY"] [MAKE LOVE TO THE CROWD]
sentences.zh: [老派] [谁是你爸爸？] [“骑小马”] [与人群做爱]

sentences.en: [SMACKING THAT ASS] [STIR THE POT OF LOVE] [HANGING OUT ... CASUAL] [WORD.]
sentences.zh: [打那个屁股] [搅动爱的锅] [闲逛......休闲] [文字。]

sentences.en: (Applause) I invented the Placebo Camera.
sentences.zh: （掌声）我发明了安慰剂相机。

sentences.en: (Laughter) It doesn't actually take pictures, but it's a hell of a lot cheaper, and you still feel like you were there.
sentences.zh: （笑声）它实际上并不拍照，但是便宜很多，而且你仍然感觉身临其境。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Clears his throat) (Laughter) "Dear Sir, good day, compliments of the day,
sentences.zh: （笑声）（清清喉咙）（笑声）“亲爱的先生，美好的一天，今天的赞美，

sentences.en: and my best wishes to you and family. (Breathes in) I know this letter will come to you surprisingly, but let it not be a surprise to you, for nature has a way of arriving unannounced, and, as an adage says, originals are very hard to find,
sentences.zh: 并向您和家人致以最良好的祝愿。 （吸气）我知道这封信会令人惊讶地到达你的手中，但不要让你感到惊讶，因为大自然有办法不事先通知就到达，而且，正如一句谚语所说，原件很难找到，

sentences.en: but their echoes sound ouder. So I decided to contact you myself, for you to assure me of safety and honesty, if I have to entrust any amount of money under your custody.
sentences.zh: 但它们的回声听起来更怪异。因此，我决定亲自联系您，如果我必须将任何金额委托给您保管，请您向我保证安全和诚实。

sentences.en: I am Mr Micheal Bangura, the son of late Mr Thaimu Bangura who was the Minister of Finance in Sierra Leone but was killed during the civil war.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·班古拉先生，已故泰穆·班古拉先生的儿子，泰穆·班古拉先生曾任塞拉利昂财政部长，但在内战期间阵亡。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Knowing your country to be economical conducive for investment, and your people as transparent and trustworthy to engage in business, on which premise I write you.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我知道你们的国家在经济上有利于投资，你们的人民在商业上是透明和值得信赖的，在这个前提下我写信给你们。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Before my father death, he had the sum of 23 million United States dollars, which he kept away from the rebel leaders during the course of the war.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我父亲去世前，他拥有2300万美元，这是他在战争期间向叛军领导人保留的。

sentences.en: (Laughter) This fund was supposed to be used for the rehabilitation of water reserves all over the country, before the outbreak of war.
sentences.zh: （笑声）这笔基金本应在战争爆发前用于恢复全国各地的水储备。

sentences.en: When the war broke out, the rebel leader demanded the fund be given to him, my father insisted it was not in his possession, and he was killed because of his refusal to release the fund.
sentences.zh: 战争爆发时，叛军领导人要求将这笔资金交给他，我父亲坚称这笔资金不在他手中，他因拒绝释放这笔资金而被杀。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, my mother and I is the only person who knows about it because my father always confide in me.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我和我的母亲是唯一知道这件事的人，因为我的父亲总是向我吐露心声。

sentences.en: (Sighs) I made an arrangement with a Red Cross relief worker, who used his official van to transport the money to Lungi Airport, Freetown, although he did not know the real contents of the box.
sentences.zh: （叹气）我和一名红十字救援人员做了安排，他用他的官方货车将钱运送到弗里敦的隆吉机场，尽管他不知道盒子里的真实内容。

sentences.en: (Laughter) The fund was deposited as a family reasure, in a safe, reliable security company in Dakar, Senegal, where I was only given temporary asylum.
sentences.zh: （笑声）这笔资金被存放在塞内加尔达喀尔一家安全可靠的保安公司，作为家庭保障，我在那里只得到了临时庇护。

sentences.en: I do not wish to invest the money in Senegal due to unfavorable economic climate, and so close to my country.
sentences.zh: 我不想把钱投资在塞内加尔，因为塞内加尔经济环境不利，而且离我的国家很近。

sentences.en: The only assistance I need from you, which I know you would do for me, are the following: one, be a silent partner and receive the funds in your account in trust; two, provide a bank account under your control
sentences.zh: 我需要您提供的唯一帮助（我知道您会为我做的）如下：第一，成为一个沉默的合作伙伴，并以信托形式接收您账户中的资金；二、提供您控制下的银行账户

sentences.en: to which the funds will be remitted; three, receive the funds into your account in trust; take out your commission; and leave the rest of the money until I arrive, after the transfer is complete.
sentences.zh: 资金将汇往何处；三、将资金接收到您的信托账户；取出你的佣金；并把剩下的钱留到我到达、转账完成后。

sentences.en: Sincerely, Mr Micheal Bangura." (Laughter) (Applause) This is really embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 诚恳的说,Micheal Bangura先生。" (笑声) (掌声)这真的很尴尬。

sentences.en: I was told backstage that I have 18 minutes.
sentences.zh: 后台告诉我我有18分钟时间

sentences.en: I only prepared 15. (Laughter) So if it's cool, I'd like to just wait for three.
sentences.zh: 我只准备了15个(笑声) 所以如果这很酷的话,我想等3个

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Laughter ends) I'm really sorry.
sentences.zh: (笑声) (笑声结束) 我真的很抱歉。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) What's your name? (Laughter)
sentences.zh: (笑声) (掌声) 你叫什么名字?

sentences.en: Mark Surfas. It's pretty cool, huh? Pursuing happiness.
sentences.zh: 马克·苏法斯 挺酷的 追求幸福

sentences.en: (Laughter) Are you a virgin? Virgin? I mean -- no, I mean like in the TED sense?
sentences.zh: 你是处女吗?

sentences.en: (Laughter) Are you? Oh, yeah? So what are you, like, a thousand, two thousand, somewhere in there?
sentences.zh: 是吗 那你是什么人 一千两千块

sentences.en: Huh? Oh? You don't know what I'm talking about?
sentences.zh: 你不知道我在说什么吗?

sentences.en: (Laughter) Ah, Mark -- (Laughter) Surfas.
sentences.zh: (笑) 啊,马克 - (笑) 苏法斯。

sentences.en: (Laughter) 1,860 -- am I good? And that's nothing to be ashamed of.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 1,860 -- 我好吗?那没什么好羞耻的。

sentences.en: That's nothing to be ashamed of. (Applause) Yeah, I was hanging out with some Google guys last night.
sentences.zh: 这没什么好羞耻的。 (掌声) 是啊,我挂出 一些谷歌的家伙昨晚。

sentences.en: Really cool, we were getting wasted. (Laughter) And they were telling me that Google software has gotten so advanced that, based on your interaction with Google over your lifetime,
sentences.zh: (笑声) 他们告诉我Google软件已经变得如此先进, 根据你和Google在一生中的互动关系,

sentences.en: they can actually predict what you are going to say -- (Laughter) next.
sentences.zh: 他们可以预测你接下来要说什么 -- (笑声)

sentences.en: And I was like, "Get the fuck out of here. That's crazy."
sentences.zh: 我说:"滚开,这太疯狂了"

sentences.en: (Laughter) But they said, "No, but don't show anyone."
sentences.zh: (笑声) 但是他们说,"不,但不要给任何人看。"

sentences.en: But they slipped up. And they said that I could just type in "What was I going to say next?"
sentences.zh: 但他们失手了 他们说我可以输入"接下来我要说什么?"

sentences.en: and my name, and it would tell me. And I have to tell you, this is an unadulterated piece of software, this is a real Internet browser and this is the actual Google site, and we're going to test it out live today.
sentences.zh: 和我的名字,它会告诉我。我不得不告诉你, 这是一个没有升级的软件, 这是一个真正的互联网浏览器, 这是真正的Google网站, 我们今天要对它进行现场测试。

sentences.en: What was I going to say next? And "Ze Frank" -- that's me.
sentences.zh: 我接下来要说什么? "Ze Frank"——就是我。

sentences.en: Am I feeling lucky? (Laughter) (Shouting) Am I feeling lucky?
sentences.zh: 我感到幸运吗?

sentences.en: Audience: Yes! Yeah! (Sighs) (Laughter) Ze Frank: Oh! Amazing.
sentences.zh: 观众:是的!

sentences.en: (Laughter) In March of 2001 -- (Laughter) I filmed myself dancing to Madonna's "Justify My Love."
sentences.zh: (笑声) 2001年3月-- (笑声) 我拍摄了自己 跳舞到麦当娜的"理顺我的爱。"

sentences.en: On a Thursday, I sent out a link to a website that featured those clips to 17 of my closest friends, as part of an invitation to my -- an invitation to my th -- th -- 26th birthday party.
sentences.zh: 在星期四,我发了一个链接到一个网站 上面有这些剪辑 给17个我最亲密的朋友, 作为邀请的一部分,邀请我参加我的26岁生日派对。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Clears throat) By Monday, over a million people were coming to this site a day.
sentences.zh: 周一,超过100万人 每天来到这个网站。

sentences.en: (Sighs) (Laughter) Within a week, I received a call from Earthlink that said, due to a 10 cents per megabyte overage charge, I owed them 30,000 dollars.
sentences.zh: (叹气) (笑) 一周内,我接到地球连线的电话说, 由于每兆字节超额收费10美分, 我欠他们30,000美元。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Needless to say, I was able to leave my job.
sentences.zh: （笑声）不用说，我能够辞掉工作。

sentences.en: [WAS LAID OFF] (Laughter) And, finally, you know, become freelance.
sentences.zh: [被解雇]（笑声）最后，你知道，成为自由职业者。

sentences.en: (Laughter) [UNEMPLOYED] But some people refer to me more as, like, an Internet guru or -- [JACKASS] swami.
sentences.zh: （笑声） [失业] 但有些人更多地称我为互联网大师或——[JACKASS] 斯瓦米。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I knew I had something. I'd basically distilled a very difficult-to-explain and complex philosophy, which I won't get into here, because it's a little too deep for all of you, but --
sentences.zh: （笑声）我知道我有一些东西。我基本上提炼出了一种非常难以解释和复杂的哲学，我不会在这里深入讨论，因为它对你们所有人来说都有点太深了，但是——

sentences.en: (Laughter) It's about what makes websites popular, and, you know, it's -- [DANCE LIKE AN IDIOT AND DON'T SELL ANYTHING] It's unfortunate that I don't have more time.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 这是关于网站受欢迎的原因，而且，你知道，它是—— [像个白痴一样跳舞，不要卖任何东西] 不幸的是我没有更多的时间。

sentences.en: Maybe I can come back next year, or something like that.
sentences.zh: 也许我明年可以回来，或者类似的事情。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I'm obsessed with email. I get a lot of it.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 我对电子邮件很着迷。我得到了很多。

sentences.en: Four years later, I still get probably two or three hundred emails a day from people I don't know, and it's been an amazing opportunity to kind of get to know different cultures, you know?
sentences.zh: 四年后，我每天仍然会收到大约两三百封来自我不认识的人的电子邮件，这是一个了解不同文化的绝佳机会，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's like a microscope to the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 它就像世界其他地方的显微镜。

sentences.en: You can kind of peer into other people's lives.
sentences.zh: 你可以窥视别人的生活。

sentences.en: And I also feel like I get a lot of inspiration from the average user.
sentences.zh: 而且我还觉得我从普通用户那里得到了很多灵感。

sentences.en: For example, somebody wrote, "Hey Ze, if you ever come to Boulder, you should rock out with us," and I said, "Why wait?"
sentences.zh: 例如，有人写道，“嘿泽，如果你来博尔德，你应该和我们一起摇滚，”我说，“为什么要等？”

sentences.en: [rocking out] (Video) (Music) And they said, "Hey Ze, thanks for rocking out, but I meant the kind of rocking out where we'd be naked."
sentences.zh: [摇滚]（视频）（音乐）他们说，“嘿泽，谢谢你的摇滚，但我的意思是我们赤身裸体的那种摇滚。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) And that was embarrassing. But you know, it's kind of a collaboration between me and the fans, so I said, "Sure."
sentences.zh: （笑声） 这很尴尬。但你知道，这是我和粉丝之间的一种合作，所以我说，“当然。”

sentences.en: [rocking out naked] (Video) (Music) (Laughter) I hear a lot of you whispering.
sentences.zh: [裸体摇滚]（视频）（音乐）（笑声）我听到你们很多人在窃窃私语。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I know what you're saying, "Holy crap!
sentences.zh: （笑声）我知道你在说什么，“天哪！

sentences.en: How is his presentation so smooth?" (Laughter) And I have to say that it's not all me this year.
sentences.zh: 他的演讲怎么这么顺利？” （笑声）我不得不说，今年这不全是我的。

sentences.en: I guess Chris has to take some credit here, because in years past, I guess there's been some sort of subpar speakers at TED.
sentences.zh: 我想克里斯在这里应该得到一些功劳，因为在过去的几年里，我想 TED 上有一些低于标准的演讲者。

sentences.en: I don't know. And so, this year, Chris sent us a TED conference simulator.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。因此，今年，克里斯给我们发送了一个 TED 会议模拟器。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Which really allowed us as speakers to get there, in the trenches, and practice at home so that we would be ready for this experience.
sentences.zh: （笑声）这确实让我们作为演讲者能够到达那里，在战壕里，在家练习，以便我们为这次经历做好准备。

sentences.en: And I've got to say that, you know, it's really, really great to be here.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，你知道，来到这里真是太棒了。

sentences.en: (Pre-recorded applause) I'd like to tell all of you a little joke.
sentences.zh: （预录鼓掌）我想给大家讲一个小笑话。

sentences.en: (Pre-recorded applause and cheering) Not just the good stuff, though.
sentences.zh: （预先录制的掌声和欢呼声）不过，不仅仅是好东西。

sentences.en: You can do heckler mode. Voice: Hey, moron, get off the stage!
sentences.zh: 你可以进行质问模式。声音：嘿，白痴，下台！

sentences.en: ZF: You get off the stage. (Laughter) Voice: We want Malcolm Gladwell.
sentences.zh: ZF：你下台。 （笑声） 声音：我们想要马尔科姆·格拉德威尔。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Baby cooing) (Huge crowd applauding) In case you run over time.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（婴儿咕咕声）（一大群人鼓掌）以防你超时。

sentences.en: (Heroic music) Just one last thing I'd like to say, I'd, really -- (Laughter) I'd like to thank all of you for being here.
sentences.zh: （英雄音乐）我想说的最后一件事，我真的——（笑声）我要感谢你们所有人来到这里。

sentences.en: (Loud music) (Laughter) And frog mode. (Singing) (Sings) "Ah, the first time that I made love to a rock shrimp --"
sentences.zh: （大声的音乐）（笑声）还有青蛙模式。 （唱）（唱）“啊，我第一次和岩虾做爱——”

sentences.en: (Laughter) [Spam jokes are the new airplane jokes] (Sighs) It's true.
sentences.zh: （笑声）[垃圾邮件笑话是新的飞机笑话]（叹气）这是真的。

sentences.en: Some people say to me, "Ze, you're doing all this stuff, this Internet stuff, and you're not making any money."
sentences.zh: 有些人对我说，“泽，你在做这些事情，这些互联网的事情，但你却没有赚到任何钱。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "Why?" And I say, "Mom, Dad -- (Laughter) I'm trying."
sentences.zh: （笑声）“为什么？”我说，“妈妈，爸爸——（笑声）我正在努力。”

sentences.en: I don't know if you're all aware of this, but the video game market, kids are playing these video games, but, supposedly, there's tons of money.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们是否都意识到这一点，但是在视频游戏市场，孩子们正在玩这些视频游戏，而且据说有大量的钱。

sentences.en: I mean, like, I think, 100,000 dollars or so a year is being spent on these things.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想，每年大约要花 10 万美元在这些事情上。

sentences.en: So I decided to try my hand. I came up with a few games.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定尝试一下。我想出了一些游戏。

sentences.en: (Laughter) This is called "Atheist." I figured it would be popular with the young kids.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 这就是所谓的“无神论者”。我认为它会受到小孩子的欢迎。

sentences.en: OK. Look, I'll move around and say some things.
sentences.zh: 好的。听着，我会走动并说一些话。

sentences.en: (Sighs) [Game over. There is no replay.]
sentences.zh: （叹气）[游戏结束。没有重播。]

sentences.en: (Laughter) So that didn't go over so well.
sentences.zh: （笑声）所以事情进展得不太顺利。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I don't really understand why you're laughing.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我真的不明白你为什么笑。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Should have done this before I tried to pitch it.
sentences.zh: （笑声）在我尝试推销之前就应该这样做。

sentences.en: "Buddhist," of course, looks very, very similar to "Atheist."
sentences.zh: 当然，“佛教徒”看起来与“无神论者”非常非常相似。

sentences.en: (Laughter) But you come back as a duck. (Laughter) And this is great because, you know, for a quarter, you can play this for a long time.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 但你回来后却变成了鸭子。 （笑声）这很棒，因为，你知道，一个季度，你可以玩很长时间。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And Chris had said in an email that we should really bring something new to TED, something that we haven't shown anyone.
sentences.zh: （笑声）克里斯在一封电子邮件中说，我们真的应该给 TED 带来一些新的东西，一些我们还没有向任何人展示过的东西。

sentences.en: So, I made this for TED. It's "Christian."
sentences.zh: 所以，我为 TED 做了这个。这是“基督教”。

sentences.en: It's the third in the series. I'm hoping it's going to do well this year.
sentences.zh: 这是该系列的第三篇。我希望今年能取得好成绩。

sentences.en: (Sighs) (Laughter) Do you have a preference?
sentences.zh: （叹气）（笑声）你有偏好吗？

sentences.en: (Laughter) Good choice. (Laughter) So you can wait for the Second Coming, which is a random number between one and 500 million.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 不错的选择。 （笑声）所以你可以等待第二次降临，这是一个 1 到 5 亿之间的随机数。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So really, what are we talking about here?
sentences.zh: （笑声）那么说真的，我们在这里谈论什么？

sentences.en: Oh, tech joy. (Laughter) Tech joy, to me, means something, because I get a lot of joy out of tech.
sentences.zh: 哦，技术的乐趣。 （笑声）科技带来的快乐对我来说意义重大，因为我从科技中得到了很多快乐。

sentences.en: And in fact, making things using technology -- and I'm being serious here, even though I'm using my sarcastic voice -- I won't -- hold on.
sentences.zh: 事实上，利用技术来制造东西——我在这里是认真的，尽管我用的是讽刺的声音——我不会——坚持下去。

sentences.en: Making things, you know -- making things actually does give me a lot of joy.
sentences.zh: 创造东西,你知道 -- 创造东西确实给了我很多快乐。

sentences.en: It's the process of creation that keeps me sort of a bubble and a half above perpetual anxiety in my life, and it's that feeling of being about 80 percent complete on a project -- where you know you still have something to do,
sentences.zh: 创造的过程使我保持了某种气泡 并超越了我一生中的一半的焦虑, 并且它使我感觉 大约80%的精力都用在了一个项目上-- 你知道你还有事情要做,

sentences.en: but it's not finished, and you're not starting something -- that really fills my entire life.
sentences.zh: 但它还没有完成, 而你没有开始的东西 - 这真的填满了我的整个生活。

sentences.en: And so, what I've done is, I started getting interested in creating online social spaces to share that feeling with people who don't consider themselves artists.
sentences.zh: 因此,我所做的是, 我开始有兴趣 创建在线社交空间 与那些不认为自己是艺术家的人分享这种感觉。

sentences.en: We're in a culture of guru-ship. It's so hard to use some software because, you know, it's unapproachable, people feel like they have to read the manual.
sentences.zh: 我们处在指导文化中,很难使用软件 因为,你知道,这是不可理解的,人们觉得他们必须阅读手册。

sentences.en: So I try to create these very minimal activities that allow people to express themselves, and, hopefully -- ("The End" by The Doors)
sentences.zh: 所以我尝试创造这些极小的活动 让人们能够表达自己, 并且,希望-- ("门"的结束)

sentences.en: Whoa! I'm like -- on the page, but it doesn't exist.
sentences.zh: 哇,我很喜欢,在页面上,但它并不存在。

sentences.en: (Laughter) It's, like -- seriously, though -- (Laughter) I try to create meaningful environments for people to express themselves.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 这是一样,说真的,虽然-- (笑声) 我试图创造有意义的环境 让人们表达自己。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Here I created a contest called, "When Office Supplies Attack," which, I think, really resonated with the working population.
sentences.zh: 在这里,我创造了一个竞赛, 叫做"当办公室用品攻击," 我认为,这真的 与工作人口产生共鸣。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Over 500 entries in three weeks.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 超过500个条目在三周内。

sentences.en: Toilet paper fashion. (Laughter) Again, people from all over the country.
sentences.zh: 厕所的纸张时尚。 (笑声)再次,来自全国各地的人。

sentences.en: The watch is particularly incredible. (Laughter) Online drawing tools -- you've probably seen a lot of them.
sentences.zh: 这个手表特别不可思议。 (笑声) 在线绘图工具,你可能已经看过很多了。

sentences.en: I think they're wonderful. It's a chance for people to get to play with crayons and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们很棒,这是人们玩蜡笔的好机会

sentences.en: But I'm interested in the process of creating, as the real event that I'm interested in.
sentences.zh: 但我对创造过程很感兴趣 作为我感兴趣的真正事件

sentences.en: And the problem is that a lot of people suck at drawing, and they get bummed out at this, sort of, you know, stick figure, awful little thing that they created.
sentences.zh: 问题是,很多人在画画方面很烂, 他们对于他们创造的 可怕的小东西感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And eventually, it just makes them stop playing with it, or they draw penises and things like that.
sentences.zh: 最终,它只是让他们停止玩它, 或者他们画阴茎之类的东西。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So, the Scribbler is an attempt to create a generative tool.
sentences.zh: 所以,Scribbler 是一个尝试 创建一种基因工具。

sentences.en: In other words, it's a helping tool. You can draw your simple stick figure, and it collaborates with you to create sort of a post-war German etching.
sentences.zh: 换句话说,这是一个帮助工具。你可以绘制你的简单的棍形图, 它会与你合作来创造一种战后德国刻画。

sentences.en: (Laughter) In fact, it's tuned to be better at drawing things that look worse.
sentences.zh: 事实上,它更适合 画更糟糕的东西。

sentences.en: So, we go ahead, and we start scribbling.
sentences.zh: 所以,我们继续前进,我们开始编织。

sentences.en: So the idea is that you can really, you know, partake in this process, but watch something really crappy look beautiful.
sentences.zh: 所以这个想法是,你可以真正,你知道, 参与这个过程, 但看一些非常糟糕的看起来美丽的东西。

sentences.en: And here are some of my favorites. This is the little trap marionette that was submitted to me.
sentences.zh: 这是我最喜欢的一些东西。这是提交给我的小陷阱木偶。

sentences.en: Very cool. (Laughter) Darling. Beautiful stuff.
sentences.zh: 酷极了 亲爱的 漂亮的东西

sentences.en: I mean this is incredible. An 11-year-old girl drew this and submitted it.
sentences.zh: 我是说这太不可思议了 一个11岁女孩画的 并提交了这个

sentences.en: It's just gorgeous. (Laughter) I'm dead serious here.
sentences.zh: 真是太美了 我是认真的

sentences.en: This is not a joke. (Laughter) But, I think it's a really fun and wonderful thing.
sentences.zh: 这不是个玩笑。 但是,我觉得这是一个非常有趣和美妙的事情。

sentences.en: So this is called the "Fiction Project."
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的"幻想项目"

sentences.en: This is an online space, which is basically a refurbished message board that encourages collaborative fiction writing.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在线空间, 它基本上是一个翻新的 信息板,鼓励合作写小说。

sentences.en: These are haikus. None of the haikus were written by the same person.
sentences.zh: 这些是Haikus 没有一个是同一个人写的

sentences.en: In fact, each line is contributed by a different person at a different time.
sentences.zh: 事实上,每条线是由不同的人在不同的时间贡献的。

sentences.en: I think that the "now tied up, tied down, mistress cruel approaches me, now tied down, it's up."
sentences.zh: 我觉得"现在绑起来,绑起来, 情妇残酷接近我, 现在绑起来,它上升。"

sentences.en: It's an amazing way, and I'll tell you, if you come home, and your spouse, or whoever it is, says, "Let's talk" -- That, like, chills you to the very core.
sentences.zh: 这是一个惊人的方法,我会告诉你, 如果你回家,你的配偶, 或不管是谁, 说,“让我们谈谈”——这,就像,让你寒心到核心。

sentences.en: (Laughter) But it's peripheral activities like these that allow people to get together, doing fun things.
sentences.zh: 但这种外围活动 让人们可以聚在一起 做一些有趣的事

sentences.en: They actually get to know each other, and it's sort of like low-threshold peripheral activities that I think are the key to bringing up some of our bonding social capital that we're lacking.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上了解了对方, 这有点像低门槛的外围活动 我认为是关键 来筹集一些我们缺少的社会资本。

sentences.en: And very, very quickly -- I love puppets.
sentences.zh: 很快地,我爱木偶。

sentences.en: Here's a puppet. It dances to music. Lotte Reiniger, an amazing shadow puppeteer in the 20s, that started doing more elaborate things.
sentences.zh: 这是木偶 音乐舞 洛特·雷尼格 20年代一个很棒的影子木偶 开始做更复杂的事

sentences.en: I became interested in puppets, and I just want to show one last thing to you.
sentences.zh: 我开始对木偶感兴趣 我只想给你看最后一件事

sentences.en: Oh, this is how you make puppets. (Applause) Chris Anderson: Ladies and gentlemen, Mr. Ze Frank.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们 泽弗兰克先生

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
